scientific_integrity: Exact identity proven for every real alpha>0 and every integer n>=5 in the uniform intrinsic-circle model. The 69 exact integer-power finite checks are diagnostics, not a substitute for the all-power proof. No independent audit or absolute priority certificate is implied.
scientific_limitations: Excludes n=3,4 and nonuniform or higher-dimensional samples. A previously published interval ordinary-length result uses some of the same local moments; historical priority of the all-power circle identity remains qualified.
title: Exact positive count–power-length covariance for circular reciprocal nearest neighbors
